anika (revops): Heads-up — multiple customers reported duplicate invoices this morning. Looks correlated to Stripe webhook retries.

josh (eng-billing): any examples?

anika (revops): cust: cus_GAMMA, invoice stripe id: inv_st_9071. Two NetSuite invoices were created for same stripe invoice id. CS flagged billing confusion.

marta (finance): saw the AR dashboard pop — duplicates cause net-dollar mismatch and some refunds failed because NS refund logic picked the wrong invoice.

leo (eng-platform): quick hypothesis: our gateway strips Idempotency-Key on retries so downstream producer sees different requests and emits duplicate create events. Also confirm whether we populate external_reference on NS payload.

josh (eng-billing): we rely on payload.external_id === stripe.invoice.id to dedupe in the sync job. If external_id is missing, NetSuite sees it as new. We do set it usually, but the retry path in the webhook handler might rehydrate differently.

anika (revops): here's one of the webhook headers from the customer's logs (redacted):
```
Stripe-Signature: t=167... ; v1=...
Idempotency-Key: <MISSING>
X-Forwarded-For: 34.23.1.99
```

marta (finance): so missing idempotency key could be the proxy problem. How many duplicates? AR report shows 7 customers, 9 duplicate invoices overnight.

leo (eng-platform): immediate mitigation: 1) reconfigure API gateway to preserve Idempotency-Key header for inbound Stripe retry requests. 2) add a sync-side safeguard: if incoming invoice payload contains stripe_invoice_id and we already have an open NS invoice with that external id, skip create and emit a reconciliation alert. I'll open a quick PR and deploy to staging.

josh (eng-billing): add to that: if external_id is missing, fallback to stripe_id from payload.metadata and log an audit event. Also add an idempotency check in the producer using a short-lived cache (30m) keyed by stripe.signature+amount to avoid double-emits on retries.

anika (revops): CS — please hold any mass customer notifications until we list affected accounts. I'll prepare messaging that explains duplicate invoices and that we're consolidating.

billing-bot: incident_create: duplicate-invoice-sync  severity=low impacted=9 ops_owner=josh

marta (finance): finance ops will need to merge or void duplicates in NetSuite and reconcile refunds. Can we provide a CSV of affected NS ids + stripe ids?

josh (eng-billing): yes. I'll run a query to map by stripe_invoice_id and dump NS invoice ids. Also will attach raw webhook payloads for the event window.

leo (eng-platform): deploy plan: 1) staging fix for header preservation + producer fallback -> asap, 2) canary to prod for 1 hour, 3) enable sync-side dedupe and alerting. Backfill: run a dedupe scan for last 48 hours and produce reconciliation CSV.

anika (revops): backfill and CSV are priority so CS can reconcile with customers. Also pause any auto-refunds for invoices created in the last 24h until cleanup completes.

josh (eng-billing): noted. I'll add a flag to the refund worker to skip invoices created between 1999986400 and 1999990000 and surface a manual queue.

marta (finance): follow-ups: 1) finance ops cleanup CSV, 2) reconcile refunds, 3) confirm gateway header fix, 4) consider permanent idempotency telemetry on webhook ingest.

leo (eng-platform): staging push in 20m. Will post canary results in this thread. :rocket:

billing-bot: deploy_started: preserve-idemp-header v1.0 -> staging (sha: e4f1a2)

leo (eng-platform): staging tests show header preserved and dedupe path triggered on replay. scheduling 1h prod canary.

marta (finance): thanks. CS notified and finance ops standing by to reconcile.
